verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure and hierarchy: the quote mark, quote, attribution and corner logo all survive. Its flaws are that the can sits up and off-center in the cropped maroon circle and the bottom-left is left empty. B breaks the grouping: the attribution is pulled out to the right inside the grey circle, enlarged until it competes with the quote, and the logo floats awkwardly under the quote. B also shrinks the can and leaves the bottom-right empty, so it reads as scattered and lopsided.
